title: RB Jeremiyah Love is worth a high draft pick — but he has a flaw that needs work

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: RB Jeremiyah Love is worth a high draft pick — but he has a flaw that needs work
sources.description: Love is going to be one of the scariest players in the league in the open field. He's too athletic, too fast and too big for most back seven players when he has the space to operate.
